issue.body:
The current implementation (see below) does not allow comparing instances of `ImmutableMultiDict` to instances of other `Mapping` types, such as dicts.

This makes testing less convenient. For example, I was trying to check what was received via `Request.query_params` (`QueryParams`), but then have to cast it to a `dict` (which makes testing `MagicMock.method_calls` cumbersome).

https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/c8b9581e371968b4da42d0f2de01e4028d71ac3c/starlette/datastructures.py#L301-L304
issue.title: ImmutableMultiDict should be comparable (__eq__) to other mappings
